text:
Maria K: Quick sync — we need tight hero and subhead variants for Hosted API / Dedicated / Private pages. Can we lock two each by EOD Friday?
Jon P: Ack. sharing a lightweight matrix in a sec.
Maria K: cool. main goals: 1) make value prop clear for each buyer (dev velocity, predictable throughput, data isolation), 2) surface benchmark callouts + CTA to demo/webinar.
Priya S: For Hosted hero: short, product-led line + low-friction CTA. Idea: `Ship LLM features in minutes. Pay-as-you-go, fast API.`
Leo G: For Dedicated: highlight predictable capacity + SLA. Idea: `Dedicated GPU pools. Predictable throughput, enterprise SLAs.`
Ashwin R: Private page should lead with security + deployment flexibility: `Private deployment options: VPC and on‑prem with KMS/HSM.`
copybot: /suggestion: include one-line benchmark blurb under hero: `Typical latency < 40ms p50 for short prompts on Hosted`
Jon P: I like the benchmark blurb — but it must be defensible. Use "p50" not "avg". Also call out embeddings cost-per-1k if we have numbers.
Maria K: We don't want numbers we can't stand behind. Let's use ranges: `p50 < 50ms` and `embeddings from $X / 1k tokens`? maybe avoid $X.
Priya S: Alternate: "Latency and cost optimized for production workloads" as a single line under hero to avoid exact figures.
Leo G: Proposed CTAs: Hosted -> "Try Hosted API" (free credits); Dedicated -> "Request Dedicated quote"; Private -> "Talk to sales / private demo".
Ashwin R: For the Dedicated page, add a small inline bullet row: "Autoscaling policies, Burst capacity, SLA-backed". Keep bullets to 3.
Jon P: Also we need a tiny compare strip: Hosted | Dedicated | Private — one-liners, primary differentiator, target buyer. I can draft.
Maria K: Great. Also want a secondary module for "Benchmarks & Evals" linking to a deep-dive blog/webinar replay. CTA: "See benchmark tests".
Priya S: Webinar idea: 30min + live Q&A. Focus: "How to lower inference cost without sacrificing latency" + 2 short case studies.
Leo G: I'll set up a landing query param for webinar leads and add UTM. Include a lightweight form with checkbox: "Interested in Dedicated/Private" to route inbound leads.
Maria K: Routing plan: leads with checkbox selected -> SDRs get flagged as enterprise; otherwise auto-send Hosted onboarding sequence. Priya, confirm.
Priya S: Confirmed. Also add a tag to GA event: `landing_engagement:hero_cta`
Ashwin R: Small content ask for eng: one short paragraph on runtime optimizations (batching, KV caching) with a link to architecture docs. I'll write it.
Jon P: I'll upload a 2‑column hero mock with copy variants to Figma this afternoon and tag everyone.
Maria K: Perfect. For writing: everyone add 1-2 suggested headlines by noon tomorrow. We'll pick finalists in a 15-min review. :thumbsup:
Leo G: Noted. I'll also draft the webinar registration flow and routing rules.
copybot: Reminder: Demo env deploy scheduled at 1800457200 (perops).
Maria K: Thanks — let's iterate.
